format_note: This is Familyr's proposed one-screen clinician brief. It is not an Impiricus-preferred vendor format; Impiricus format was not available to the team.

sources.title: Talking With Your Older Patients — National Institute on Aging

one_screen_layout.row_3: changes (0–5 bullets with current vs baseline)

allowed_recommendations.label: Review evidence
allowed_recommendations.meaning: Open cited messages and confirm the pattern before acting.

allowed_recommendations.label: Contact patient or caregiver
allowed_recommendations.meaning: A short, non-diagnostic check-in may clarify context.

allowed_recommendations.label: Consider clinical screening
allowed_recommendations.meaning: If the pattern persists, clinician may consider validated screening at the next visit. Not an order.

allowed_recommendations.label: Document and monitor
allowed_recommendations.meaning: Record the observation and continue passive monitoring.

forbidden_claims: Any diagnosis (e.g., dementia, MCI, depression, anxiety disorder)
Disease stage or severity grading presented as clinical fact
Probability or likelihood of dementia or depression
Claims that silence or absence of chat means a symptom is absent
Statements that Familyr replaces clinical judgment or validated tools

label_policy.stable: P01–P05 — team expected review labels; rename to clinician labels only after a clinician annotates.
label_policy.review_suggested: P06–P10 — team expected review labels for patterns that warrant human review without diagnosing.
